title: Tags
description: The tags module displays the current state of tags in river.

num-tags.label: Num tags
num-tags.doc: The number of tags that should be displayed. Max 32.
num-tags.description: The number of tags that should be displayed. Max 32.

tag-labels.label: Tag labels
tag-labels.doc: The label to display for each tag.
tag-labels.description: The label to display for each tag.

disable-click.label: Disable click
disable-click.doc: If set to false, you can left-click to set focused tag. Right-click to toggle tag focus. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.
disable-click.description: If set to false, you can left-click to set focused tag. Right-click to toggle tag focus. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.

set-tags.label: Set tags
set-tags.doc: An array of tag bitmasks, one per tag button. Left-clicking a tag sets the focused tags to the corresponding bitmask instead of the single tag. Requires disable-click to be false.
set-tags.description: An array of tag bitmasks, one per tag button. Left-clicking a tag sets the focused tags to the corresponding bitmask instead of the single tag. Requires disable-click to be false.

toggle-tags.label: Toggle tags
toggle-tags.doc: An array of tag bitmasks, one per tag button. Right-clicking a tag toggles the corresponding bitmask in the focused tags instead of the single tag. Requires disable-click to be false.
toggle-tags.description: An array of tag bitmasks, one per tag button. Right-clicking a tag toggles the corresponding bitmask in the focused tags instead of the single tag. Requires disable-click to be false.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

hide-vacant.label: Hide vacant
hide-vacant.doc: Only show relevant tags: tags that are either focused or have a window on them.
hide-vacant.description: Only show relevant tags: tags that are either focused or have a window on them.
